page: UpCloud CLOUDNATIVE-12xCPU-32GB is a Cloud Native family server running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 shared x86_64 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 7542 processor clocked at 2.0 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 12 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, 32.0 GB of system memory providing 2.67 GB per core, and no local storage. The CPU cache architecture consists of a 64 KB L1d cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache, and 16 MB L3 cache. Supported instruction sets and hardware flags include AVX, AES, SHA_NI, BMI2, ADX, and FMA. The server is provisioned with one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark data indicates average multi-core and memory performance alongside poor single-core execution. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is rated in the bottom 10% at 787.29, while the multi-core performance reaches an average tier of 9386.96. Memory bandwidth tests show average results, with read-only small block cached speeds at 1223.58 GB/sec and uncached large block write speeds at 42.64 GB/sec. Geekbench testing yields a single-core score of 1204.0 and a multi-core score of 7735.0, placing its software compilation, ray tracing, and image processing capabilities in the middle tier. For language model tasks, the server achieves an average prompt processing speed of 41.39 tokens/sec on a medium 7B model, but drops to a poor 4.94 tokens/sec for text generation.

Given the shared CPU allocation and lack of bundled local storage, this server offers a resource-dense configuration suitable for workloads that do not require dedicated CPU cores. The 12 vCPUs and 32.0 GB RAM profile delivers balanced multi-threaded capabilities for general-purpose applications. It is appropriate for static web serving, which registers a throughput of 9.33 GB/sec, and database operations, scoring 6982.15 on PassMark. The server is also suited for Redis deployments, handling 17.5 million SET operations per second, as well as multi-threaded decompression tasks and moderate background processing.

It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.67 GB per core, and lacks local storage.
